llc.formation_notes: No publication requirement found. Foreign LLC Application for Authority is $275.

annual_report.name: Annual Report / Renewal
annual_report.due: On the anniversary date of the original filing; SOS sends a notice about 45 days before

state_tax_on_llc.name: Corporate Activity Tax (CAT)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: Any business entity (LLCs and sole proprietors included) with more than $1 million of taxable Oregon commercial activity; registration required above $750,000
state_tax_on_llc.notes: $250 plus 0.57% of taxable Oregon commercial activity over $1 million, after a 35% subtraction for certain expenses. No Oregon LLC franchise or minimum tax otherwise; a single-member LLC is disregarded for income tax.

sources.title: Oregon Secretary of State, Business Registry Fee Schedule
sources.quote: LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANIES ... Domestic ... Articles of Organization $100.00 ... Renewal (Annually) $100.00

sources.title: Oregon DOR, Corporate Activity Tax
sources.quote: The tax is computed as $250 plus 0.57 percent of taxable Oregon commercial activity of more than $1 million.

sources.title: Oregon SOS, Answers to Business Registration Questions
sources.quote: Your renewal will be due on the anniversary date of the original filing.

entity_level_taxes.name: S corporation minimum excise tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: Flat $150 for an S corporation doing business in Oregon (excise tax filers); does not flow through to shareholders. Tax on built-in gains and excess net passive income also applies if taxed federally.

entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate Activity Tax (CAT)
entity_level_taxes.notes: $250 + 0.57% of taxable Oregon commercial activity over $1 million; applies to all entity types

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: PTE-E: 9% on the first $250,000 of distributive proceeds, 9.9% above; elected annually by S corps and partnerships. SB 1510 (2026 session) extends it to tax years beginning before 2028-01-01. For 2026 only, the 1st and 2nd quarterly estimated payments are both due June 15.

sources.title: Oregon DOR, S corporations
sources.quote: An S corporation carrying on or doing business in Oregon must also pay $150 minimum excise tax.

sources.title: Oregon DOR, Pass-Through Entity Elective (PTE-E) Tax
sources.quote: Senate Bill 1510 in the 2026 legislative session extends the PTE-E program through tax years beginning before January 1, 2028.

sources.title: Oregon DOR, Corporate Activity Tax
sources.quote: Only taxpayers with more than $1 million of taxable Oregon commercial activity will have a payment obligation.

personal_exemption.notes: $260 credit per exemption (2026 estimated indexed figure); $0 if federal AGI over $100,000 (single/MFS) or $200,000 (MFJ/HOH/QSS). Head of household standard deduction $4,650; HOH uses the joint (Chart J) rates.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: No state surtax. Federal tax subtraction of $0 to $8,750 for 2026 (phases out with AGI). Reduced rate available for qualified business income (Oregon-specific election). Local personal income taxes: Metro SHS and Multnomah PFA (see local_taxes).

sources.title: Oregon DOR, 2026 Publication OR-ESTIMATE
sources.quote: Single or married filing separately: $2,900. ... Married filing jointly or Qualifying surviving spouse: $5,800

estimated_tax.required_if: Expect to owe $1,000 or more after withholding and credits (including refundable credits)
estimated_tax.notes: Required annual payment is the lesser of 90% of 2026 tax or 100% of 2025 tax (no 110% high-income rule); annualized method allowed. Self-employment tax is not included. Farmers/fishermen with 2/3 of gross income from farming/fishing are exempt.

unemployment_2026.notes: Tax Schedule 3 for 2026 (rates 0.9%-5.4% per press release). Oregon also has Paid Leave Oregon contributions and transit payroll taxes, not covered here.

local_taxes.name: Business License Tax (BLT)
local_taxes.applies: Net business income of businesses (sole proprietors included, single-member LLC filed at owner level) doing business in Portland
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Exempt if gross receipts from all business everywhere are under $75,000 for tax years beginning in 2026 ($50,000 before 2026; $100,000 from 2027). Owner's compensation deduction up to 75% of net business income, capped at $160,500 per owner for tax years from 2025 (2026 cap not read).
local_taxes.quote: $75,000 for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2026 and prior to January 1, 2027

local_taxes.name: Business Income Tax (MCBIT)
local_taxes.applies: Net business income of businesses doing business in Multnomah County (administered by Portland Revenue Division)
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Exempt if gross receipts from all business are under $100,000. Owner's compensation deduction up to 75% of net business income, capped at $158,500 per owner for tax years from 2025 (2026 cap not read).
local_taxes.quote: Multnomah County Business Income Tax rate: 2%

local_taxes.place: Metro (Portland region: parts of Clackamas, Multnomah, Washington counties)
local_taxes.name: Supportive Housing Services (SHS) Personal Income Tax
local_taxes.applies: Metro taxable income above the threshold (residents on all income; nonresidents on Metro-source income). Sole proprietors and disregarded entities pay this instead of the SHS business tax.
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: 2026: over $128,000 single/MFS, over $205,000 joint/HOH/QSS ($125,000/$200,000 for 2021-2025; $132,000/$211,000 for 2027); now inflation-indexed

local_taxes.name: Supportive Housing Services (SHS) Business Income Tax
local_taxes.applies: Net income of businesses operating in Metro with total gross receipts over $5 million
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Gross receipts of $5,000,000 or less exempt; sole proprietors and disregarded entities exempt (they pay the SHS personal tax)
local_taxes.quote: Metro Supporting Housing Services (SHS) Business Income Tax rate: 1%

local_taxes.name: Preschool for All (PFA) Personal Income Tax
local_taxes.applies: Multnomah County taxable income of residents, people working in the county, or with county-source income
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: 1.5% over $125,000 single / $200,000 joint, plus an additional 1.5% (3% total) over $250,000 single / $400,000 joint. Thresholds not indexed. The scheduled 0.8% increase is now set for 2028 (not 2026).
local_taxes.quote: an additional 1.5% on Multnomah County taxable income over $250,000 for individuals and $400,000 for joint filers. The rate will increase by 0.8% in 2028.

local_taxes.name: TriMet transit self-employment tax
local_taxes.applies: Net self-employment earnings from business carried on in the TriMet District (filed with Oregon DOR, Form OR-TM)
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: $400 exclusion of net self-employment earnings (per DOR form instructions for the parallel LTD tax; not re-read for OR-TM)
local_taxes.quote: The transit tax rate is 0.8237% of the wages paid by an employer

local_taxes.name: LTD transit self-employment tax
local_taxes.applies: Net self-employment earnings from business carried on in the Lane Transit District (Form OR-LTD)
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Net self-employment earnings over $400; one $400 exclusion
local_taxes.quote: The tax rate is 0.0080 (.8000 of 1 percent).

notable: No sales tax, but a top income tax rate of 9.9% starting at only $125,000 taxable income for single filers (https://www.oregon.gov/dor/forms/FormsPubs/publication-or-estimate_101-026_2026.pdf)

Personal exemption is a $260 nonrefundable credit, not a deduction, and is lost above $100,000/$200,000 federal AGI (https://www.oregon.gov/dor/forms/FormsPubs/publication-or-estimate_101-026_2026.pdf)

Portland-area freelancers can stack Portland BLT 2.6% + Multnomah BIT 2% on net business income, plus Metro SHS 1% and PFA 1.5%-3% on high personal income, plus TriMet 0.8237% on self-employment earnings (https://www.portland.gov/revenue/business-tax)
Portland BLT small-business exemption rises from $50,000 to $75,000 of gross receipts in 2026 and $100,000 in 2027 (https://www.portland.gov/revenue/business-tax)
Metro SHS personal tax thresholds are inflation-indexed from 2026: $128,000 single / $205,000 joint (https://www.portland.gov/revenue/personal-tax)

Corporate Activity Tax hits every entity type, including LLCs and sole proprietors, above $1 million of Oregon commercial activity (https://www.oregon.gov/dor/programs/businesses/Pages/corporate-activity-tax.aspx)
PTE-E SALT workaround extended through tax year 2027 by SB 1510 (2026 session) (https://www.oregon.gov/dor/programs/businesses/Pages/pass-through-entity-elective-tax.aspx)
uncertain: 2026 income tax brackets, standard deduction ($2,900/$5,800) and exemption credit ($260) are the DOR's 'estimated Oregon indexed figures for tax year 2026' published in Oct 2025; final 2026 return figures may differ slightly.
Annual report late penalty: no official LLC-specific late fee or dissolution timing read today (an SOS FAQ about nonprofits mentions 45 days; not applied here).
Portland and Multnomah owner's compensation deduction caps for tax years 2026 not read; only the 2025 caps ($160,500 Portland, $158,500 Multnomah) from SP-2025 instructions.
TriMet rate 0.8237% read on trimet.org (page updated Feb 2026) without an explicit '2026' label; no DOR 2026 OR-TM instructions read. LTD 0.80% read on the 2025 DOR form instructions only.
Portland Arts Tax (per-resident flat tax) exists but amount not verified today.
Metro SHS / PFA pages read on portland.gov (Revenue Division administers both on behalf of Metro and Multnomah County); oregonmetro.gov and multco.us not separately read.
